title: 第十三章 神奇内丹
content_zh:
“咳咳咳，你四处走走，让本女王想想，太长时间没来这里了”

    当那充斥着满洞的紫色气体完全进入李磊体内后这铸魔洞窟里面的全貌也是浮现在了李磊眼前。

    令李磊没有想到的是这铸魔洞窟是如此之破，如果说铸魔洞窟之前还有那紫色气体的存在显得十分神秘，可现在的铸魔洞窟仿佛就是在大山之中随随便便的一个山洞一样，只不过这个山洞时不时会有紫色光华浮现。

    “这……也太破了吧”李磊打量着铸魔洞窟四周抱怨道。

    “有了!你去这个洞窟右边的墙壁上找找看，看看有没有机关”

    “让我看看”

    李磊也是听从了石头的话来到了洞窟右边的墙壁，开始仔细摸索起来。

    “没有!你到底靠不靠谱啊”

    本来李磊满是期待的搜索这面墙壁，可随着时间的流逝李磊甚至摸遍了整面墙都没有找到石头所说的机关。

    “那可能是左边的墙壁，嘿嘿”石头尴尬的笑道。

    这石头并非故意在耍李磊，只是年代实在是久远石头一时忘记这机关到底在哪个方位了。

    “咔哒!”

    “找到了”

    随着机关发出的声音，李磊也终于成功在左边的墙壁找到并开启了。

    李磊本以为机关开启后会发现新大陆，可是令李磊大吃一惊的是机关开启后李磊眼前只是多出了一个巴掌大小的锦囊口袋。

    “这就是你非让我取的东西？你是在开玩笑？说好的三样东西呢？”李磊满脸不解的问道。
content_en:
"Ahem, cough, cough, walk around and let me think about it. It's been too long since I've been here."

    When the purple gas that filled the cave completely entered Li Lei's body, the entire scene inside the Demon Casting Cave appeared before Li Lei's eyes.

    What Li Lei didn't expect was that the Demon Casting Cave was so broken. If the existence of the purple gas in the Demon Casting Cave was very mysterious before, the current Demon Casting Cave seems to be just like a random cave in the mountains, except that purple brilliance emerges from this cave from time to time.

    "This... is too shabby," Li Lei complained as he looked around the Demon Casting Cave.

    "Yes! Go and look on the wall on the right side of this cave to see if there is any mechanism."

    "Let me see"

    Li Lei also followed Shi Shi's words and came to the wall on the right side of the cave and began to explore carefully.

    "No! Are you reliable?"

    Li Lei originally searched this wall with great expectations, but as time passed, Li Lei even searched the entire wall but could not find the mechanism Shitou mentioned.

    "That might be the wall on the left, hehe" Shitou smiled awkwardly.

    The stone was not deliberately playing tricks on Li Lei, but it was so old that the stone temporarily forgot where the mechanism was.

    "Click!"

    "Found it"

    Following the sound of the mechanism, Li Lei finally succeeded in finding and opening it on the left wall.

    Li Lei originally thought that he would discover a new continent when the trap was opened, but what surprised Li Lei was that after the trap was opened, there was only a palm-sized pocket of tips in front of him.

    "Is this what you insist on asking me to take? Are you kidding me? Where are the three things you agreed on?" Li Lei asked with a puzzled look on his face.
title_en: Chapter Thirteen The Miraculous Inner Elixir
